rows.en: What is it? Stand and face me! Have at you!
It can't be helped… I'll be your opponent! Come at me from wherever you like!
Then here I come!

Lady Bijinder… In that state, you have no hope of defeating me, have you?

Knowing you cannot win, you still accept my challenge…?

Lady Bijinder! Do you loathe me so much… loathe this Waruder?

Haah…

I am beaten!

I, Waruder, am utterly beaten! I see there is no longer any room for me in your heart!

That being so, from this very day I shall become your true and genuine enemy, and await the time when we may have a fair fight! Farewell…
Waruder… You're not that kind of person… Aagh…
Heh heh heh…
You're pretty weak now, aren't you, Bijinder!?
Uuugh… So now you'll be my opponent, Shadow Knight?

Heh heh heh… I'd love to… but I want to test what this thing can do!

Fight your own shadow double and die!

Nuoooh…!?

You mean to get in my way, Waruder?

I shall not interfere… I simply do not care for such methods!

That is the Shadow-Double Generator, which Shadow spent many long years to finally complete!

It emits a powerful light that gives life to any shadow and turns it into a robot for just three minutes…

Heh heh heh… Exactly, Waruder!

And the special feature of this Shadow-Double Robot is that it is twice as strong as the original that cast the shadow!

And… a Shadow-Double Robot has the exact opposite character of its original, does it not?

Which means my shadow double will be good, the opposite of evil… The shadow double of a champion of justice shall leap out!

Now, throw the switch!
Nngh, Waruder! The stronger you get, the stronger the Shadow-Double Robot becomes, you know!

Heh heh heh… Fool! Behold! The just Waruder (Shadow) is born!

Shadow Knight… You have created your own enemy with your own hands!

The just Waruder (Shadow) will be Shadow's enemy!

…!?

Damn it! Waruder! You'll pay for this!
Lady Bijinder… Leave this to me. Now, please, flee!
Waruder…
Hold it, I won't let you!
I am Bijinder (Shadow)! Come on, Bijinder… I'm not about to lose to the likes of you!
Wh-what!? Waruder (Shadow)… Are you not the bearer of a good heart?

Heh heh heh…

I don't know what's good and what's evil! I just do whatever I please.

He knows not what is good and what is evil?

Even my shadow… even my own shadow has a heart of half-measures…

Curses… If only I had a heart that could tell good from evil, even as well as a dog can…
Here I come, Waruder!
Nngh… You'll pay for this, Waruder!
Bijinder! We'll call this fight a draw for now! Next time, I'll kill you all for sure.
What are you doing, Shadow Knight!?

Sir… I am terribly sorry!

Ngh, that Waruder…
Big Shadow, sir… Leave this to me! I'll make things interesting.
Hahaha… The Agony Circuit?

Yes…

Shadow Knight! Switch on the Agony Circuit!
I see… I'll teach that Waruder a lesson!
Lady Bijinder… Are you all right? Are you not hurt?

A special bomb had been set inside Mari's body! It was designed to explode when Mari's third button was undone!

And… Mari does not know it.
Uuugh… Aaah…
…!? Lady Bijinder, what is the matter? If there is anything I can do, tell me!
Aaah… Uuugh… My chest… loosen it at my chest…
Understood! I'll undo the buttons now…
Hahaha… Now this is getting interesting!

Heh heh heh… At this rate, Waruder will die along with her!

This is worth watching! Come on, one more… Waruder! Hurry and undo the third button!
Lady Bijinder… Just a little longer!

…!?

A special bomb!? I see… Big Shadow, you play dirty!

Forgive me, Lady Bijinder!

…!?

Blast… Waruder's noticed it! What is he going to do?

…!?

It is made so that carelessly removing the special bomb would cost Lady Bijinder her life!

Damn you… Big Shadow! How far will you go with your dirty tricks!?

Yes… If I install part of my own energy circuit, Lady Bijinder will not die even if the special bomb is removed…

But then my own life would last only a few days…

Lady Bijinder… Even if it costs me my life, I will remove this thing from your body, without fail!
Ah…
Big sister!
"Big sister"? You are an acquaintance of Lady Bijinder?
Is she dead?

No, she is not! I shall surely…

By the way, who might you be?

I'm looking for Big Sister Rieko! I bet… Shadow took her away!

But… I really, really want to see Big Sister Rieko.

Hahaha… Is that all!?

Very well, follow me!

Nngh… That Waruder, getting in the way at the crucial moment!

…!?
Let go, I said! Is this any way to treat a lady!?
Big Shadow, sir… I have brought Misao and Hiroshi.

Oh, splendid! Very good!

Behold, Shadow Knight… Hiroshi and Misao have just now fallen into the hands of our Shadow!
Then… the Giant Devil?

With the blueprints on this Hiroshi's back, the Giant Devil's body can be built!

But its vital core can't be made without Akira's back, no matter what!

Shadow Knight! Bring Akira here, even if you have to kill him!
Yes, sir!

…!?

What? Waruder!?

You have some nerve showing your face…

…!?

That child… is Akira!?

Oh… Well done, Waruder!

Catching Akira even before Shadow Knight, no less!
This child… says he wishes to see Lady Rieko… Where is Lady Rieko?

What!?

He just tagged along all the way to this Shadow base to see Rieko?
Where's my big sister? Let me see Big Sister Rieko!

Hahaha…

This is delightful! A hostage who came to see a hostage, and Waruder who showed him the way… What a fine pair!

Take them away!
Get in there!
Waah…

…!?

Akira!

Hey, hey, Shadow Knight!

Never mind us… but if you kill Akira and Hiroshi here, you won't be able to build the Giant Devil!

Are you fine with that?

No need to worry… The blueprints on their backs have already been copied. The Giant Devil is complete!

We have no more use for you! In a few minutes, the time bomb will go off! Savor your terror to the fullest, then drop dead… Hahaha…
Hey, at a time like this… is it "Namu Amida Butsu"… or "Amen"? Which one?
Sis, calm down!
Giant Devil! Oh, Giant Devil…
Yes… Big Shadow, sir…
Giant Devil… Show me your power! The power of the strongest giant robot in the world…
Leave it to me… I shall crush those Kikaiders with a flick of the wrist for you to see.
Go forth, Giant Devil!

uncertain: U09940-U09992: Waruder's archaic samurai speech rendered in old-fashioned English; ご貴殿/殿 as "Lady Bijinder", "Lady Rieko".
U09943: [ja] read as "you have no hope of defeating me, have you?"
U09954/U09961: ワルダー影 rendered with the glossary form "Waruder (Shadow)" inside dialogue.
U09966: 勝負は、あずけた as "we'll call this fight a draw for now".
U09977: 膤 read as 胸; Mari asks for her clothing at the chest to be loosened, leading to the buttons.
U09980: "そら、もうひとつだ" read as "one more [button]".
U09989: Akira asks if Mari (Bijinder) is dead; "she" from context.
U10012: Misao's tomboyish rough speech kept rough.
omissions_kept: U09948: "this thing" - the Shadow-Double Generator, introduced in the next rows.
